name: Collateral Value Report V 02
definition: The CollateralValueReport message is sent by the system transaction administrator to a system member (such as a directly connected party) to provide further information the current available value of securities for auto collateralisation for one specific or several cash accounts.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Set of elements to identify the collateral value report message.

ReportOrError.name: Report Or Error
ReportOrError.definition: Report on collateral value information or operational error.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
